documents.title: AI Code of Ethics and Minimum Standards (AI Ethical Considerations and Guidance)
documents.quality_note: University-wide standards; faculty are expected to state AI expectations in syllabi (allowed, disclosure, not permitted); violations can bring discipline.

notes: Provost's Generative AI Task Force report and syllabus-statement guidance were referenced in search results but not located as fetchable text (academicaffairs and CID pages had only 2-4 AI mentions and no policy; not kept). No computer science or college-level AI policy found.
